reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate that every holiday check in the tree already goes through.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; the MM-DD match is one extra includes in the shared predicate.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule stays in shared/schedules.ts beside the weekend logic it belongs to.

scope.why: Predicate, a type comment, tests and a release note only.

maintainability.why: A small, commented change in the single place that decides whether a day is a holiday, so getNextDate, upcoming dates, range dates and templates all get it.
